summary: Full backend + frontend testing for HYPEBLOCK Graffiti Gremlins. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passing (stats, list/filter/search/sort, detail, traits, waitlist create/duplicate/count, admin auth/mark/delete). Frontend: Home, Gallery (filter, search, pagination), NFT detail with prev/next, and Admin login (wrong+correct key) all working. Waitlist form submits successfully and appears in admin table.

integration_issues.issue: waitlist-count on Home shows 0 even after successful submission (does not refresh); admin table correctly shows entry. Likely missing re-fetch/state update after submit.

action_items: Minor: refresh waitlist-count on Home after successful WaitlistForm submission (event/callback or re-fetch /api/waitlist/count).
Note: rarity-filter test-ids use lowercase tier (e.g. rarity-filter-legendary) not capitalized as documented in task spec — update docs or make consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses `logger` inside startup event but `logger` is defined AFTER app.include_router (line 399). Currently works because the seed_collection is scheduled at startup; but the `logger` reference is only reached at runtime, so no crash. Still, define logger at top of file for safety.
load_dotenv called before importing routes is fine; ADMIN_KEY defaulted to 'hypeblock2026' in code — acceptable given .env override.
MongoDB queries correctly project out _id via {'_id': 0}. Good.
Pydantic EmailStr on WaitlistCreate — good; email lowercased before dedupe. Consider adding a unique index on waitlist.email to prevent race duplicates.
